title: Queenstown in Aug
meta_desc: Plan a family trip to Queenstown in August 2026. Weather, events, and top activities for kids. Budget $350-600/day for a family of 4. Best for ages 5+.
intro: Queenstown is a year-round destination, but August is a great time to visit with kids. The winter season is in full swing, with ski fields open and a range of indoor and outdoor activities to enjoy. With some planning, you can have a fantastic family holiday in Queenstown without breaking the bank.

sections.heading: Weather in August
sections.body:
August is winter in Queenstown, with average highs of 8°C and lows of 1°C. It's a great time to enjoy the ski fields, with Coronet Peak and The Remarkables open from mid-June to early October. Be sure to pack warm clothing, including jackets, gloves, and hats.

While it can be chilly, August is also a great time to enjoy the scenic beauty of Queenstown, with the mountains and lakes looking particularly stunning in the winter light.

sections.heading: What's On in August
sections.body:
August is a great time to enjoy the winter events in Queenstown, including the Queenstown Winter Festival. This festival typically takes place in late June, but some events may still be happening in early August.

The Remarkables Market is also on every Saturday during the summer months, but may be closed in August due to the winter season. However, there are still plenty of other markets and events to enjoy, including the Queenstown Arts Centre's winter exhibition.

sections.heading: Best Activities for Families in August
sections.body:
There are plenty of great activities for families to enjoy in Queenstown in August. The Skyline Gondola and Luge are a must-do, with stunning views of the town and lake. The Queenstown Ice Arena is also a great place to spend a cold winter's day, with ice skating and other activities available.

For older kids, the Ziptrek Ecotours and Kjet/Dart River Jet are great adventures to enjoy. And for a more relaxing day out, take a scenic walk along the Lake Wakatipu foreshore or visit the beautiful Queenstown Gardens.
list: Skyline Gondola and Luge ($40-$60 per person)

sections.heading: Practical Tips for Families
sections.body:
Queenstown can get busy in August, especially during the school holidays. Be sure to book your accommodation and activities ahead of time to avoid missing out.

It's also a good idea to pack warm clothing and waterproof gear, as the weather can be unpredictable. And don't forget to take advantage of the free activities on offer, such as the Queenstown Gardens and frisbee golf.

Pack warm clothing and waterproof gear
Consider purchasing a Queenstown Card for discounts and savings
Check the weather forecast before heading out each day
